comment: Evolution is additive-only: never delete or repurpose components, props, variants, interaction states, or calm-tech fields; add new names and deprecate old names with replacement notes. Motion note 1.7.0: KStyle.ease is the founder-blessed zen timing curve; springs are forbidden; reduced motion removes movement animations while retaining opacity feedback through easeFast. Typography and haptics note 1.8.0: KStyle font tokens scale through UIFontMetrics with size-specific tracking, and semantic commit events route to sensory feedback triggers. Cadence note 1.9.2: KBlockRow owns the active-bandish lifecycle stream, KNowPanel is deprecated for cadence, signal/ring colors resolve through KStyle tokens, and non-current cadence rows plus sidebar stats sit directly on the environment haze. Provenance catalog note 1.10.0: A2UIPanel/ProvenanceCard/EvidenceRow/ConfidenceBadge/ClaimStatus/ChangeActionBar are the shared k0.provenance/claim/change/eval_score/evolve_report + loop.evidence composition (design-system plan 003 U5); confidence/status resolve through KSignal only, never a new hue. Control-taxonomy note 1.11.0: founder-blessed mind-v18, bio-v11, cadence-v7, and chat-v16 establish uppercase inset-track selectors, a circular 44pt input control, the filled-primary/hairline-secondary/naked-archive verdict register, quiet borderless acts, and the named cadence selector color sequence; KBlockRow and KNowPanel are descriptor-only deprecations replaced by BandishCard. Chat-v16 motion note 1.11.1: named zen-curve tokens own in-place expansion, stack continuity, append-only history, thinking-to-answer crossfade, and chrome reveal; status dots breathe opacity only. Nav note 1.12.0: KNavBar is the additive floating root nav — circle-family icon capsule, bottom bar on compact width and right side rail on regular width, selection is an ink-bright glyph plus a hairline ring and never a fill; KTabStrip remains the inset-track text selector. Chat grammar note 1.13.0: KChatVerbDrawer and KChatActionRow are the chat-v33 grammar surface — the verb drawer keeps its receipt inside and the three-tier action row is latest-only with ✓-chip demarcation; a chosen action is a command, never an utterance. Selector grammar note 1.14.0: KSelectorStrip is the shared in-panel uppercase inset-track selector for Bio's state and biology/meditation domain bars; wider 44pt targets, a quieter 48pt track, and token-owned motion keep the language singular. Loading grammar note 1.15.0: KLoadingPrimitive is the shared no-shimmer skeleton or quiet loading-dot treatment for every fetch-bound surface; loading never reads as empty or unreachable. Dead-code sweep note 1.15.1: BuildWorkingArea, BuildIntentInput, BuildStreamColumn, BuildReportRail, BuildReportInlineCard, ChatMealQuickEntryRow, ContextBar's view, BioLogEntryRow, and CadenceRestStripModel are deprecated retired names; their coverage entries are removed, while live model/catalog history remains additive. Selector refinement note 1.15.2: KSelectorStrip inherits the bandish mode-pill inset, sibling seam, compact visual height, tighter side padding, and separate 44pt hit floor across Bio and retro consumers. Loading audit-hook note 1.15.3: KLoadingPrimitive additionally exposes its accessibility identifier through an in-tree 1×1 clear marker sibling because grouped-element exposure is context-flaky under XCUI; visual treatment is unchanged.

components.name: KBlockRow
components.semanticRole: deprecated BandishCard re-copy retained as catalog history only

props.name: timeText
props.description: lowercase or numeric time gutter copy

props.name: why
props.description: secondary reason text from the served block

props.name: titleSuffix
props.description: small dim title suffix such as work brain state

props.name: badge
props.description: one-word status such as now or next

props.name: content
props.description: pure typed-bandish rendering contract: optional metaSuffix appended to the mono metadata line, detailLines rendered as KMonoCaption rows under why, checklist rendered as KChecklistRow rows, and liveLine ignored on timeline rows

props.name: timeGutter
props.description: start/duration gutter with optional struck original values

props.name: activeFillColor
props.description: ring-token fill for started current cards

props.name: surfaceTone
props.description: dark-glass default or light-glass cadence stream tone

props.name: actionState
props.description: available, started, or completed lifecycle state

props.name: onStart
props.description: tap-to-start handler for current available cards

whenToUse: deprecated: use BandishCard for cadence and build timeline rows
neverUse: never instantiate in product or showcase code
never extend this descriptor with new behavior

components.name: KBlockDetail
components.semanticRole: single-column block detail route with title, time, why, metadata, detail sections, and optional quiet actions

props.name: meta
props.description: mode, ring, type, and type-specific metadata

props.name: sections
props.description: KDetailSection rendering contract: optional header, mono detail lines, and optional KChecklistRow checklist

whenToUse: use for cadence block drill-ins that preserve type-specific richness after founder intent
use when DetailSection lines and checklist rows need one quiet reading column
neverUse: never use as an inline timeline expansion
never place inside a card or secondary sheet

components.name: KSensesRail
components.semanticRole: ambient regular-width rail of source-labeled body, capacity, and nutrition sense groups

props.name: groups
props.description: body, capacity, and nutrition groups with source labels and lines

whenToUse: use on regular-width cadence for peripheral body, capacity, and nutrition readings
use only when existing fetched data has at least one line to render
neverUse: never use card material, borders, or fills for the rail groups
never render placeholder dashes for absent sources

components.name: KNowPanel
components.semanticRole: deprecated duplicate of the current BandishCard state retained as catalog history only

props.name: meta
props.description: remaining time, mode, ring, and type metadata

props.name: content
props.description: pure typed-bandish rendering contract: optional metaSuffix appended to the mono metadata line, detailLines rendered as KMonoCaption rows under why, checklist rendered as KChecklistRow rows, and liveLine rendered as quiet mono copy under the countdown

props.name: state
props.description: default, empty, stale, or offline state

whenToUse: deprecated: use the current BandishCard lifecycle state
neverUse: never instantiate in product or showcase code
never extend this descriptor with new behavior

components.name: KNextRow
components.semanticRole: quiet mono next line with label, start time, and title

props.name: state
props.description: default, empty, stale, or offline state

whenToUse: use directly under cadence now to name the next block without promoting it
use when start time and title should scan as metadata
neverUse: never use for full timeline rows
never decorate the next item with a card or badge

components.name: KRestStrip
components.semanticRole: single quiet mono line for the remaining day shape after next

props.name: state
props.description: default, empty, stale, or offline state

whenToUse: use below KNextRow to keep the day's remaining shape peripheral
use for up to four compact start-time and title pairs
neverUse: never show elapsed blocks here
never use as a scrollable or tappable timeline

components.name: KCapacityLine
components.semanticRole: quiet mono remaining capacity line with optional secondary-route tap

props.name: state
props.description: default, empty, stale, or offline state

whenToUse: use for cadence's peripheral per-mode attention budget summary
use when tapping opens the secondary capacity drawer
neverUse: never show zero or missing modes
never promote capacity above the now instrument

components.name: KPaperCard
components.semanticRole: quiet paper-tone card for nudge, review, and decision content

whenToUse: use for the lighter card tone extracted from cadence nudges and review cards
use when a surface needs slight grouping without platform glass
neverUse: never nest inside another card
never use for chrome, decoration, or marketing-style panels

components.name: KGlassCard
components.semanticRole: semantic glass-tone card for depth panels and scrollable utility surfaces

whenToUse: use for the stronger glass tone extracted from build depth panels and evidence blocks
use when the card needs to survive future platform material changes
neverUse: never introduce a third card tone
never expose platform material directly at call sites

components.name: KColumnPanel
components.semanticRole: sanctioned floating column panel tone over the camera layer

props.name: content
props.description: tab column body supplied by caller

whenToUse: use for genuine floating panels, detail routes, drawers, and sheets
use through kColumnPanelTone only when content needs a separate material layer
neverUse: never use as the default five-tab root shell
never use inside cards, rows, or packet content
never expose platform material directly at call sites

components.name: KActRow
components.semanticRole: quiet lowercase text actions separated by middle dots

props.name: selectedActionIDs
props.description: selected action ids rendered at the calm active emphasis

whenToUse: use for quiet answerable text acts such as complete, skip, reschedule, approve, or retry
use when recognition of available actions matters more than visual priority
neverUse: never use for the fixed mind verdict bar
never add icons, filled pills, or badges

components.name: KOptionButton
components.semanticRole: build decision option button with primary fill or quiet hairline treatment

props.name: variant
props.description: primary filled or quiet hairline treatment

whenToUse: use for build card options that need a primary-filled or quiet-hairline treatment
use when kill-class options replace their label with sure? on the second-tap confirmation window
neverUse: never use for quiet text acts that belong in KActRow
never introduce local button styles for build card options

components.name: KMonoCaption
components.semanticRole: monospaced lowercase status, staleness, metadata, or footer caption

whenToUse: use for written status visibility and inline recovery messages
use for stale snapshot, footer, and metadata lines
neverUse: never use for primary content paragraphs
never hide errors in alerts or icon-only controls

components.name: KStatusDot
components.semanticRole: semantic signal dot for live, attention, error, offline, or idle state

props.name: size
props.description: small, regular, or large dot size

whenToUse: use when color is reserved for semantic connection, block, or unit signals
use alongside copy when the state needs initial recognition
neverUse: never use as decoration
never encode arbitrary categories with color

components.name: KLoadingPrimitive
components.semanticRole: shared no-shimmer fetch loading treatment with dim skeleton lines or a quiet loading dot

whenToUse: use for every fetch that has not resolved to loaded, empty, or unreachable
use skeleton for content-shaped waits and dot for an inline stream wait
neverUse: never shimmer, pulse, or spin
never use as the empty or unreachable state
never create a private loading skeleton or loading dot in a surface

components.name: KTabStrip
components.semanticRole: root doctrine selector with mono uppercase labels in an inset track and a filled active state

props.name: staleTabs
props.description: tabs whose dot should render stale

props.name: notificationItems
props.description: unified notification rows that own tab dot presence

whenToUse: use only for the app's top doctrine selector
use dots for waiting state without counts
neverUse: never add icons, blue tint, or numbered badges
never render the active tab as text-only
never use for in-panel segmented controls

components.name: KSelectorStrip
components.semanticRole: shared in-panel selector with uppercase labels, compact bandish pills, and one filled active state

props.name: items
props.description: stable selector values, labels, and accessibility hooks

whenToUse: use for in-panel tabs and domain selectors that share the uppercase inset-track grammar
use when every item has a stable selection value and a 44pt target
neverUse: never use for root navigation: use KTabStrip or KNavBar
never use for progress/status segments with no selection
never add a second fill, border, icon, or numbered badge

components.name: KNavBar
components.semanticRole: floating root nav — circle-family icon capsule, bottom bar on compact width and right side rail on regular width, with quiet ink-bright ring selection

props.name: axis
props.description: horizontal bottom bar or vertical side rail

props.name: staleTabs
props.description: tabs whose dot should render stale

whenToUse: use as the app's floating root nav
bottom bar on compact width, right side rail on regular width
neverUse: never fill the selected item — selection is an ink-bright glyph plus a hairline ring
never add accent tint or numbered badges
never use for in-panel navigation

components.name: KStreamRow
components.semanticRole: quiet aligned stream row with content and optional mono metadata

props.name: role
props.description: founder, k, runner, or system stream alignment

props.name: meta
props.description: mono metadata rendered under the stream line

whenToUse: use for chat and build stream rows that need founder/right and k-or-runner/left alignment
use when stream metadata belongs under the line instead of in a badge
neverUse: never use for timeline rows with semantic dots
never use for cards, summaries, or action clusters

components.name: KProgressStrip
components.semanticRole: quiet progress strip with title, progress copy, and hairline fill

props.name: title
props.description: lowercase title for the progress subject

props.name: progressRatio
props.description: progress fill ratio clamped between zero and one

whenToUse: use for a compact mission or unit-progress line inside a route surface
use when written progress and a single hairline fill need to travel together
neverUse: never use as a spinner or ambient animation
never stack more than one progress strip in the same slot

components.name: KInputBar
components.semanticRole: bottom intent input for chat, admin, and build with one circular 44pt send-or-stop control

props.name: mode
props.description: chat, admin, or build line limits and labels

whenToUse: use for one-sentence intents in chat, admin intake, and build intent
use inline text for loading, offline, and error recovery
neverUse: never add a second primary control beside send or stop
never replace inline errors with alerts or spinners

components.name: KChecklistRow
components.semanticRole: single quiet checklist item with bullet, lowercase title, and done state

props.name: foregroundColor
props.description: semantic foreground inherited by active bandish cards

whenToUse: use for cadence ops checklist lines
use when the entire row should be a 44pt toggle target
neverUse: never use a checkbox chrome glyph
never truncate the checklist title

components.name: KVerdictBar
components.semanticRole: fixed mind verdict register: filled act-on, hairline nod, naked junk/archive

whenToUse: use only for mind verdict bursts
use fixed 56pt targets that do not move between outputs
neverUse: never give the three verdicts equal bordered treatment
never change the left-to-right order

components.name: KEvidenceBlock
components.semanticRole: monospaced horizontally scrollable evidence, diff, or log block

props.name: variant
props.description: mono, gate-output, diff, or log-tail variant

whenToUse: use for build gate output, diffs, log tails, and evidence ids that need monospaced scanning
use written empty, loading, error, and offline states
neverUse: never use for prose paragraphs
never shimmer or animate loading text

components.name: KSummaryStrip
components.semanticRole: waiting-line summary of tappable segments separated by middle dots

props.name: onSelect
props.description: tap handler for the segment tab

whenToUse: use for the glance answer to what is waiting on the founder
use when each segment can route directly to the relevant tab
neverUse: never show counts as badges
never use as a general breadcrumb or nav bar

components.name: KChatVerbDrawer
components.semanticRole: quiet verb drawer for a k reply with receipt and source access

props.name: receipt
props.description: soul version and ref count shown inside the drawer

whenToUse: use on a k reply after long press or reply swipe
keep receipt inside the drawer and keep source access inline on regular width
neverUse: never add a second backdrop or corner action cluster
never invent receipt values when the packet is silent

components.name: KChatActionRow
components.semanticRole: latest-only three-tier next-action row with follow-up slider and chosen receipt chip

props.name: actions
props.description: up to three packet actions, primary last

props.name: followUps
props.description: up to three follow-up questions behind the chevron

props.name: selectedActionID
props.description: chosen action for the check chip

props.name: showFullRow
props.description: long-press restore on a previous turn

whenToUse: use only when the reply packet emits next-action fields
right-align the three tiers with the primary action at the right edge
collapse previous action turns to the chosen checkmark chip
neverUse: never fabricate an action, placeholder, or user bubble
never send action text from this row
never use a spring or a per-message clock

components.name: A2UIPanel
components.semanticRole: the one shared composition every provenance-catalog viewType renders through

props.name: packet
props.description: the k0.provenance/claim/change/eval_score/evolve_report or loop.evidence packet to render

props.name: onUndo
props.description: invoked from ChangeActionBar's undo affordance for k0.change

props.name: onChallenge
props.description: invoked from ChangeActionBar's challenge affordance for k0.change

whenToUse: use for every k0.provenance/claim/change/eval_score/evolve_report and loop.evidence packet — one shared wrapper, never five bespoke views
neverUse: never bypass A2UIPanel to render a provenance viewType directly

components.name: ProvenanceCard
components.semanticRole: one observed/proposed/changed provenance snapshot — subject, as-of time, and source evidence

props.name: subject
props.description: what the provenance snapshot is about

props.name: sourceRefs
props.description: normalized evidence rows from the packet's sourceRefs

whenToUse: use inside A2UIPanel for k0.provenance packets
neverUse: never render provenance as a bespoke route dashboard — always through A2UIPanel

components.name: EvidenceRow
components.semanticRole: one compact linked evidence row — statement plus optional surface/timestamp meta

props.name: entry
props.description: the normalized evidence entry to render

whenToUse: use for loop.evidence exposures and k0.provenance sourceRefs inside A2UIPanel
use to generalize the existing loop.evidence render path — never duplicate it
neverUse: never use for the full evidence/diff/log block — that stays KEvidenceBlock

components.name: ConfidenceBadge
components.semanticRole: semantic confidence level badge for k0.claim/k0.eval_score — maps confidence onto KSignal only

whenToUse: use for k0.claim/k0.eval_score confidence display inside A2UIPanel
neverUse: never introduce a new hue for confidence — resolve through KSignal only
never render a bare numeric percentage without a level label

components.name: ClaimStatus
components.semanticRole: a k0.claim packet's lifecycle status — proposed, promoted, challenged, or rejected

whenToUse: use inside A2UIPanel to show a k0.claim's lifecycle state next to its ConfidenceBadge
neverUse: never invent a fifth lifecycle state — proposed/promoted/challenged/rejected is the closed set

components.name: ChangeActionBar
components.semanticRole: a k0.change packet's before/after diff plus undo and challenge affordances

props.name: onUndo
props.description: tap handler for the undo action

props.name: onChallenge
props.description: tap handler for the challenge action

whenToUse: use inside A2UIPanel for k0.change packets
neverUse: never wire undo/challenge to a destructive action without a confirm step upstream
